title: Decision matrix scripts
description: Version 1 local programs that answer System One questions. A step returns the same choice, noul, or score a server would. The document is not sent to the server. Steps run in order and the first match for a question wins.
$comment: validateScripts accepts exactly the documents this schema accepts, and also checks what JSON Schema cannot: else is the last step for its question, a path nests at most 32 segments, and path segments named __proto__, prototype, or constructor are rejected. Passed a question set, it also checks that the question exists, the answer type matches, a choice is one of its labels, and a score is one of its levels.

$schema.description: Optional. Lets an editor find this schema. Ignored by the runner.

needles.description: One phrase, or a list of phrases. Any one of them can match. ASCII case is ignored.

path.description: A dotted path of names or array indexes, such as title or commit.type or items.0.subject.

paths.description: Search these fields instead of the whole state. Any one of them can match.

value.description: Compared with ===. A string is case-sensitive. A missing field does not match.

question.description: Question id this step answers. The same id may have several steps.

word.description: The phrase appears with a non-letter, non-digit boundary on each side. Underscore counts as a letter.

tag.description: The searched text starts with the token and the next character is : or (. feat matches feat: and feat(api):, and does not match feature: or feat add.

else.description: Matches when no earlier step answered this question. It has to be the last step for that question.

confidence.description: Required with choice and score. Omitted on a noul.
